title: Conveyor Belt Loop Detection
description: Imagine a factory conveyor belt system represented as a linked list of checkpoints. Some checkpoints might incorrectly link back to a previous checkpoint, creating an infinite loop. Write a function to determine if there is a cycle in the linked list representing the conveyor belt.
constraints: The number of nodes in the list is in the range [0, 10^4].
pos is -1 or a valid index in the linked-list.
input_format: The head of a linked list and an integer pos denoting the index where the tail connects.
output_format: A boolean value true if there is a cycle in the linked list, or false otherwise.

examples.explanation: There is a cycle in the linked list, where the tail connects to the 1st index.
There is a cycle in the linked list, where the tail connects to the 0th index.
There is no cycle in the linked list.
